frameworks.description: Start from an observed symptom and move through likely causes, methodological responses, targeted improvement, and related Atlas evidence.

design-stack.title: PINN Design Stack & Feedback Loops
design-stack.description: A staged design architecture showing how each upstream decision constrains downstream training and how validation evidence drives targeted redesign.
design-stack.interpretation: The stack is iterative rather than a one-pass recipe. Failed accuracy, physics, robustness, or cost checks should return the workflow to the earliest plausible design cause.

groups.title: Problem & physical system
groups.summary: Define governing equations, domain, conditions, data, scales, and computational purpose.

groups.title: Representation & architecture
groups.summary: Choose inputs, outputs, network family, features, decomposition, and inductive bias.

groups.title: Physics enforcement
groups.summary: Select strong/weak form, constraints, residual construction, and boundary treatment.

groups.title: Differentiation & sampling
groups.summary: Coordinate derivatives, collocation design, scaling, discretization, and adaptive refinement.

groups.title: Loss & optimization
groups.summary: Balance objectives, initialize, schedule learning rates, and coordinate first- and second-order phases.

groups.title: Evaluation & reliability
groups.summary: Test solution error, physics satisfaction, robustness, efficiency, uncertainty, and reporting completeness.

co-design.title: PINN Co-Design Framework
co-design.description: A systems map of the coupled decisions that jointly determine whether a PINN is mathematically appropriate, trainable, and scientifically reliable.
co-design.interpretation: No component has an independent optimum: changing representation can alter derivative spectra, loss conditioning, sampling needs, optimizer behavior, and the meaning of validation results.

groups.title: Problem purpose
groups.summary: Forward, inverse, discovery, surrogate, control, or operator-learning objective.

groups.title: Neural representation
groups.summary: Architecture, coordinates, outputs, features, domain decomposition, and parameterization.

groups.title: Physics & constraints
groups.summary: Governing operator, residual form, boundary/initial conditions, and conservation structure.

groups.title: Numerical realization
groups.summary: Differentiation, sampling, geometry, nondimensionalization, and precision.

groups.title: Training & optimization
groups.summary: Loss scaling, multi-objective balance, optimizer sequence, curricula, and stopping.

groups.title: Evaluation & reliability
groups.summary: Reference error, physics diagnostics, robustness, uncertainty, cost, and reproducibility.

design-performance.title: PINN Design–Performance Dependency Matrix
design-performance.description: A qualitative synthesis of how major design decisions influence complementary performance dimensions.
design-performance.interpretation: Relationship strength represents recurring methodological dependency across the reviewed literature; it is not an effect-size estimate and does not imply a universal monotonic effect.

failure-diagnostics.title: PINN Failure-Mode Diagnostics
failure-diagnostics.description: A challenge-oriented diagnostic map connecting observable failure symptoms to plausible design causes and targeted methodological responses.
failure-diagnostics.interpretation: A symptom can have several interacting causes. The map supports hypothesis generation and targeted testing; it does not replace problem-specific numerical diagnosis.

groups.title: Spectral bias / unresolved scales
groups.summary: Symptoms: smoothed peaks, missed high-frequency structure, phase error. Responses: feature mappings, periodic activations, decomposition, adaptive sampling.

groups.title: Optimization stagnation / ill-conditioning
groups.summary: Symptoms: plateaus, unstable gradients, initialization sensitivity. Responses: normalization, loss balancing, curricula, Adam → L-BFGS, improved initialization.

groups.title: Boundary or conservation failure
groups.summary: Symptoms: small interior residual but boundary drift or conservation defect. Responses: hard constraints, weak/integral forms, boundary refinement, dedicated physics diagnostics.

groups.title: Collocation blind spots
groups.summary: Symptoms: localized error hidden by global averages. Responses: residual-adaptive sampling, mesh-assisted refinement, stratification, maximum-error diagnostics.

groups.title: Long-time error accumulation
groups.summary: Symptoms: late-time drift, causality loss, unstable propagation. Responses: temporal decomposition, causal weighting, marching curricula, windowed validation.

groups.title: Repeated-query cost
groups.summary: Symptoms: excessive retraining or inference latency. Responses: operator learning, transfer/meta-learning, multifidelity design, reduced-order surrogates.

groups.title: Uncertainty deficit
groups.summary: Symptoms: accurate mean prediction without calibrated confidence or out-of-distribution warning. Responses: ensembles, Bayesian/UQ variants, calibration and coverage metrics.
